decision.summary: A single temporary offset interval is identified: sharp onset across N/E/U near 556–558, sustained platform until 607, with incomplete or absent return in E and U within allowed context [520,645]. The candidate reversal near 608–612 appears to initiate a return but lies just beyond the end of the sustained platform (607) and is not fully captured as a closed interval; thus the offset remains uncertain due to unobserved or ambiguous return. No confirmed temporary interval with full onset–platform–return cycle is present.

intervals.observation: Coherent multi-axis drop (N: ~−4 MAD, E: ~−15 MAD, U: ~−20 MAD) beginning sharply near index 556–558, sustained as a platform through index 607; no opposing return observed within allowed context. N shows partial recovery after 607 but not full reversal; E and U remain offset at end of window.
